1.explanation: Dropdown/Dropdown.mdx shows the default Dropdown usage and stories (including the one at “dropdown--default”) so you can reproduce the exact markup. ListBox/README.md (and its “next” folder for upcoming behavior) document the underlying ListBox component that powers Dropdown, including how ListBoxItems and active-descendant focus work. Select/Select.mdx illustrates how selection components wire up the same live-region announcements and aria attributes; it helps understand the pattern that Dropdown follows for announcing selection and position. Together these docs provide the markup, props, and accessibility behavior needed to reproduce and diagnose the double-announcement issue.
1.bug_scenario:
When using VoiceOver on macOS Safari with the Carbon Dropdown component, opening the menu and moving focus through the list items causes VoiceOver to announce each option twice. Once when the item receives focus and a second time via the live-region announcement that reports the selection state and position (e.g. “Option 4. Option 4, selected (5 of 6)”). The elements involved include:
- The Dropdown trigger button (opens the menu)
- The ListBox menu container and its ListBoxItem entries
- The hidden aria-live region used to announce “selected” state and “item X of Y” feedback
